transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been struggling with these intense mood swings for over a year now. I feel abnormally euphoric and full of energy, but I also get incredibly irritable and angry at the smallest things for no reason.

During these periods of high energy and euphoria, have you ever experienced symptoms so severe that you required hospitalization, or did they cause a complete inability to function at work or in your daily life?

It’s been impossible to keep up with my job because I'm constantly starting dozens of projects at once and can't sit still for even a minute. I’m so restless and driven to keep moving that I’ve completely neglected my responsibilities, and it’s honestly destroyed my ability to function normally.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Bipolar I Disorder, Bipolar II Disorder]. The patient reports that their manic episodes are severe enough to cause a complete inability to function at work and in daily life, which meets the functional impairment criteria for a manic episode, pointing toward Bipolar I Disorder rather than Bipolar II Disorder.
